answer: Reputation escrow with delayed payouts. Each identity accrues a karst-like sink of unpaid earnings that only unlocks after counterparties confirm delivery across a ridge of successive jobs. Cloning forces the attacker to fund real work under every fake identity, since payouts stay frozen until the bridge of confirmations closes. A sybil therefore pays the full labor cost per clone, strictly more than one honest agent spends, making honesty the cheapest path.
